task: Per-building Firestore data isolation — scope telemetry and history under each building's UID

background.app_model: Multiple phones share one Firebase Auth account per building. All phones in the same building use the same email, password, and UID. Admin phones manage the building; Sensor phones capture occupancy data for specific spaces within that building.
background.problem: Telemetry and history records are currently stored at 'rooms/{roomId}/...' with no UID in the path. This means ALL buildings share the same rooms data — a second building account would see (and pollute) the first building's history, making per-building prophet forecasting impossible.
background.goal: Move telemetry storage under the building's UID so each account owns its own data. Do NOT break any existing functionality.

rooms/{roomId}/nodes/{nodeId}.description: Latest perception snapshot for a sensor node in a room

data.roomId: string — matches the roomId segment in the path (default: 'default-room')
data.nodeId: string — Android ANDROID_ID of the sensor phone
data.lastUpdatedAt: long — epoch millis of last write
data.perceptionCapturedAt: long — epoch millis when capture ran

rooms/{roomId}/telemetry/{historyId}.description: Historical archive — one document per capture run
rooms/{roomId}/telemetry/{historyId}.data: same fields as nodes/{nodeId} plus 'historyId' string

rewatt_users/{uid}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Per-device space name — deviceId is a UUID generated once on first launch and stored in SharedPreferences key 'device_id' in 'rewatt_space_config'

data.spaceName: string — human name for the physical space this sensor covers (e.g. 'Hall 1')

rewatt_users/{uid}/rooms/{roomId}/nodes/.description: Latest perception snapshot — NOW scoped under the building UID

rewatt_users/{uid}/rooms/{roomId}/teleme.description: Historical archive — NOW scoped under the building UID

files_to_change.current_behaviour: Writes to 'rooms/{roomId}/nodes/{nodeId}' and 'rooms/{roomId}/telemetry/{historyId}'. Does not know the UID.
required_changes: Accept 'uid: String?' as a constructor parameter (nullable so the class still works if auth is absent).
When uid is non-null, use path 'rewatt_users/{uid}/rooms/{roomId}/nodes/{nodeId}' and 'rewatt_users/{uid}/rooms/{roomId}/telemetry/{historyId}'.
When uid is null, fall back to the old 'rooms/{roomId}/...' paths so the app does not crash before the user is authenticated.
No other logic changes — payload building functions (buildPerceptionPayload, buildActivityAnalysisPayload) remain identical.

key_code_locations.class_constructor: class FirebaseSyncRepository(context: Context, private val roomId: String = DEFAULT_ROOM_ID)

required_changes: Pass the current user's UID when constructing FirebaseSyncRepository.
If the UID is not yet known at construction time, pass null (safe fallback in FirebaseSyncRepository).
No logic change needed IF AppGraph passes the correct UID when constructing FirebaseSyncRepository.
If PerceptionViewModel re-creates FirebaseSyncRepository itself, pass the UID there too.

firestore_security_rules_to_update.current_rules_assumption: rules currently allow read/write on 'rooms/{roomId}/...' without UID check
new_rules_needed: Allow authenticated users to read/write 'rewatt_users/{uid}/rooms/{roomId}/nodes/{nodeId}' only when request.auth.uid == uid
Allow authenticated users to read/write 'rewatt_users/{uid}/rooms/{roomId}/telemetry/{historyId}' only when request.auth.uid == uid
Keep existing rules for rewatt_users/{uid}, rewatt_users/{uid}/devices/{deviceId}, and rewatt_usernames/{username} unchanged

prophet_integration_note.current_state: prophet_demo.py in project root generates synthetic 4-week occupancy data locally — it does NOT read from or write to Firestore. There is no live prophet integration yet.
prophet_integration_note.future_work: Wire prophet to read from 'rewatt_users/{uid}/rooms/{roomId}/telemetry/' — filter documents by perceptionCapturedAt, aggregate personCount by time slot, feed into Prophet for forecasting. Forecasts should be written back to 'rewatt_users/{uid}/rooms/{roomId}/forecast/{forecastId}' or served on-demand.

migration_notes.existing_data: Data already written to 'rooms/{roomId}/...' under the old paths will NOT be migrated automatically. If old data must be preserved, write a one-time migration script using the Firebase Admin SDK that copies documents from 'rooms/{roomId}/...' to 'rewatt_users/{uid}/rooms/{roomId}/...' for the building's UID.
migration_notes.rollout_safety: Because the UID-scoped path is purely additive (new path, same payload), the old collection can be left in place during transition and cleaned up later.
